title: Thin Layers, Not One Thick One
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 07
Thin Layers, Not One Thick One

First, the base does not need to cover the whole face.

Think of nail polish.
One thick coat does not set well, and it chips easily.
Base makeup works the same way.
Foundation, concealer and face powder alike.

Thin layers, applied with care, sit closely on the skin.
They even out the colour, little by little.

Slowly, a little at a time.
It gives shape to the face, it lasts longer, and it looks beautiful.
